hero.title: Scrap Bays Limited
hero.text: Scrap Bays Limited is a trading company that specialises in selling scrap metal, plastic scrap and waste paper scrap — all grades of ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metal, supplied to industrial buyers worldwide.

slides.alt: Used rails and HMS steel scrap
slides.label: Ferrous & non-ferrous metal scrap

values.title: Premium & Verified Products
values.text: We supply only high-grade ferrous, non-ferrous, plastic, and paper scrap that meet international quality standards. Each shipment is inspected and verified for purity and consistency to ensure our clients receive the best materials every time.

values.title: Worldwide Reach, Local Expertise
values.text: With clients and partners across Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas, we manage seamless international trade logistics. Our global presence enables us to deliver efficiently and build long-term relationships across continents.

values.title: Reliable & Transparent Service
values.text: From order to delivery, Scrap Bays Limited ensures timely communication, transparent pricing, and dependable logistics. We believe in honest trade practices and maintaining a reputation built on trust and reliability.

values.title: Committed to a Greener Future
values.text: We contribute to environmental sustainability by promoting recycling and resource recovery. Our operations reduce waste and support the global movement toward a circular economy that benefits both industry and the planet.
